settings.name: SkyHotel
settings.tagline: A harbour hotel in Port Aster

types.name: Classic Room
types.short: Cosy and calm, with everything you need for a short stay.
types.text: Our Classic Rooms face the quiet lanes of the old town. Soft linen, a reading lamp by the window and a rain shower make them an easy base for exploring Port Aster.

types.name: Deluxe Room
types.short: More room to unwind, with a king bed and a reading chair.
types.text: Deluxe Rooms add space and a sitting corner with an armchair, a writing desk and a wide window over the rooftops.

types.name: Harbour View Room
types.short: Floor-to-ceiling windows over the boats and the bay.
types.text: Wake up to masts and morning light. Harbour View Rooms have a wall of glass and, on the upper floors, a small balcony with two chairs.

types.name: Junior Suite
types.short: A separate sitting area and a freestanding bath.
types.text: Junior Suites have a bedroom alcove, a lounge with a sofa bed and a bathroom built around a deep freestanding bath.

types.name: Family Room
types.short: A king bed and two singles, with a reading corner for the kids.
types.text: Family Rooms sleep up to four with a king bed and two single beds, plus a play and reading corner with books and board games.

types.name: Penthouse Suite
types.short: The top floor, a panoramic lounge and a private roof terrace.
types.text: Two Penthouse Suites crown the hotel, each with a panoramic living room, a dining table for six and a private roof terrace facing the sunset.

home.title: A harbour hotel in Port Aster
home.text: Forty rooms above the boats, a rooftop pool facing the sunset and the old town on our doorstep.

intro.title: Stay by the water
intro.text: SkyHotel sits on Quay Lantern Walk, where the fishing boats come in each morning. Inside you'll find calm rooms, a spa, two places to eat and a front desk that knows the town.

dining.title: Dining
dining.text: Fresh catch from the quay, local wine and a bar that glows after dark.

items.name: Tidewater
items.text: Seasonal seafood and grill with a view of the harbour. Booking recommended.

items.name: Lantern Bar
items.text: Small plates, harbour cocktails and a quiet corner by the fire.

items.name: Breakfast terrace
items.text: Pastries from our own oven, eggs any way and fresh juice in the morning sun.

spa.title: Spa & wellness
spa.text: An indoor pool, a wooden sauna and three treatment rooms. Open to hotel guests every day.

items.name: Harbour massage
items.text: Full-body massage with warm sea-salt oil.

items.name: Deep sleep ritual
items.text: Back massage, scalp treatment and a lavender wrap.

items.name: Sauna & pool pass
items.text: Indoor pool 7 am – 9 pm, sauna 3 pm – 9 pm.

items.name: Rooftop pool
items.text: Heated pool with sunset views. Towels at the bar.

location.title: Getting here
location.text: 8 Quay Lantern Walk, Port Aster. Five minutes from the ferry terminal and ten from the train station.

items.name: By train
items.text: Port Aster Central, then follow the harbour path east.

items.name: By ferry
items.text: Ferries from the islands arrive at Pier 2, right across the quay.

items.name: By car
items.text: Valet parking at the front door. Electric chargers available.

membership.title: SkyHotel Circle
membership.text: Earn one point for every dollar you spend with us and unlock better rates, free breakfast and upgrades as you go.
